verdict.rationale: The only evidence of user-controlled deletion is a community report that users can delete their Shortwave account and revert to Gmail. No first-party docs describe retention settings, data deletion scope, or AI-data controls, and another user wished for a denylist to stop certain mail from syncing to Shortwave's servers. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of account/data deletion, configurable retention periods, controls over what syncs to servers, AI data-retention controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: they can move back anytime by deleting the Shortwave account
User also liked that deleting the Shortwave account made switching back to Gmail low-risk.
